ops.sql: INSERT INTO tb_customer (f_id, f_name, f_level, f_industry, f_status, f_contact, f_phone, f_address, f_remark, f_create_time) VALUES (@f_id, @f_name, @f_level, @f_industry, @f_status, @f_contact, @f_phone, @f_address, @f_remark, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE f_name=@f_name, f_level=@f_level, f_industry=@f_industry, f_status=@f_status, f_contact=@f_contact, f_phone=@f_phone, f_address=@f_address, f_remark=@f_remark
SELECT * FROM tb_customer ORDER BY f_create_time DESC
